title.value: GUILGET: GUI Layout GEneration with Transformer
title.justification: The title 'GUILGET: GUI Layout GEneration with Transformer' directly indicates the main focus and subject of the paper, which is GUI layout generation using a transformer-based method.
title.quote:
The 36th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence
5—9 June 2023, Montréal
GUILGET: GUI Layout GEneration with Transformer

extractions.description: This paper presents a method called GUILGET for automatically generating GUI layouts based on graphical constraints described as GUI arrangement graphs (GUI-AGs). It uses a transformer-based model to accommodate specific GUI design constraints, aiming to create realistic and varied GUI layouts efficiently. The methodology focuses on utilizing transformers to capture semantic relationships between GUI components and generating efficient layouts that adhere to design principles.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily discusses technical aspects of GUI layout generation without direct reference to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The design of Graphical User Interface (GUI) is an important aspect that affects the success of many software applications.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development goals or applications. Its focus is solely on graphical user interface design using deep learning techniques.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we explore an automated technique that can support designers creating GUI layouts.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper entirely focuses on GUI layout generation with no discussion of secondary categories related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
secondary_categories.quote: To address these challenges, we propose a transformer-based approach for generating GUI layouts from GUI-AGs.

primary_sub_category.justification: No subcategory within the pre-defined Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development list is applicable as the paper's content is outside the domain of sustainable development.
primary_sub_category.quote: The goal is to support the initial step of GUI design by producing realistic and diverse GUI layouts.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: As with the primary sub-category, there is no secondary one relevant since the subject matter does not overlap with sustainable development objectives.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We propose a new transformer-based method to generate GUI layouts from GUI-AGs that takes into account the GUI design constraints.

applications.quote: Creating these layouts and variations of them manually, however, can be time-consuming.
